description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Slimefoot trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Slimefoot trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land, adding {C}{C}.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
